task3_negative_controls.summary: All 8 families (2 seeds + 6 proposals) use a sign-inverted anchor book as the causal negative control. Per PLAN 8.1 the requirement is 'sign-destroying OR mechanism-destroying'; sign-flip satisfies the letter. Audit finding: a sign-flip is a WEAK control - it destroys the sign claim but not the mechanism class (it cannot distinguish an illiquidity premium from any slow persistent characteristic earning a spread), and when scored on the same decision instants the inverted book's spread is the negative of the anchor's by construction, so its falsification content comes only from independent cell scoring (separate costs/folds). This is a shared quality objection (OBJ-06), not a blocker.

On shared decision instants the inverted book's spread is the negative of the anchor's by construction; its falsification content comes solely from independent cell scoring (separate folds/costs).
